title: ng-mcp-ui build-widgets builder
description: Builds the MCP widgets bundle by delegating to @angular/build:application, then validates that every registered view emitted a code-split chunk and optionally derives views.manifest.json. Only the options below are owned by this builder; all other options are passed through verbatim to @angular/build:application.

registry.description: Workspace-root-relative path to the widget registry source file (the `registry = { ... } as const` literal) whose view names are validated against the emitted bundle graph.

manifestOut.description: Workspace-root-relative path to write the derived views manifest JSON ({ entry, styles, views }). Omit to skip manifest emission; validation still runs.

failOnMissingView.description: Fail the build when a registered view has no emitted code-split chunk on disk. When false, missing views are logged as warnings and left out of the manifest.
